1. Today is Wednesday, which is the 3rd day of the week if we count from Monday as Day 1.
2. To find out what day it will be in 10 days, we need to add 10 to the current day number.
3. In base 7 number system, we have 3 + 10 = 13. In base 10 system, 13 is a Tuesday.

So, in 10 days from now, it will be Tuesday.
